title: Matching the asset mix to the horizon
objectives: Read the horizon mix table and adjust it for risk profile and priority.
Say why must-have goals deserve a slightly more conservative mix.
body_md:
An illustrative starting point, to be adjusted for each client's risk profile and the goal's priority: under 1 year — 0% equity, 100% debt (liquid, overnight, money market funds). 1–3 years — 0–20% equity, 80–100% debt (short duration, banking & PSU, target maturity matched to the date; conservative hybrid). 3–5 years — 20–40% equity, 60–80% debt (balanced advantage / hybrid funds plus short-duration debt). 5–7 years — 40–60% equity, 40–60% debt (large/flexi-cap or index funds plus debt). 7+ years — 60–80% or more equity, 20–40% debt (diversified equity — index, flexi-cap, large & mid — plus some debt). Must-have goals deserve a slightly more conservative mix than nice-to-haves with the same horizon.

| Years to goal | Equity | Debt | Typical fund choices |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Under 1 year | 0% | 100% | Liquid, overnight, money market funds |
| 1–3 years | 0–20% | 80–100% | Short duration, banking & PSU, target maturity matched to the date; conservative hybrid |
| 3–5 years | 20–40% | 60–80% | Balanced advantage / hybrid funds plus short-duration debt |
| 5–7 years | 40–60% | 40–60% | Large/flexi-cap or index funds plus debt |
| 7+ years | 60–80% or more | 20–40% | Diversified equity (index, flexi-cap, large & mid) plus some debt |

> **Investor takeaway:** The goal date picks the asset mix; the asset mix picks the funds, never the other way round.
example: House down payment in 5 years: about 40–60% equity at most, the rest in debt — not a small-cap fund for “better returns”.
say: The goal date picks the asset mix; the mix picks the funds.
Must-have goals get a slightly more conservative mix.
never: Pick funds first, then work out the mix.
Short-term goals should be in equity for better returns.

check.q: Money needed in under a year should usually be in:
check.why: Liquid or overnight funds. No room for a market fall.

check.q: For a goal 7+ years away, the illustrative equity share is:
check.why: 60–80% or more. Adjusted to the client's risk profile.

check.q: For a goal 7+ years away, the illustrative equity share is:
check.why: 7+ years: 60–80% or more equity, 20–40% debt. Adjusted to the client's risk profile.
